title: The Animal No One Here Has Seen

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A naturalist wonders whether distant lands contain creatures as unfamiliar to Isolans as island animals might be to outsiders.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A naturalist wonders whether distant lands contain creatures as unfamiliar to Isolans as island animals might be to outsiders.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children sketch enormous grazing beasts; the naturalist distinguishes imagination from observation.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A hunter asks whether such animals would be dangerous or merely large; the group refuses to assume.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The researchers speculate about insects and microorganisms with extraordinary adaptations.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child invents a creature that can do everything; the naturalist asks what energy it would need.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A fisher proposes that migratory birds or sea creatures might connect distant shores.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A conservationist wonders whether people elsewhere struggle to protect threatened species too.
